scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison to standalone SAB parser profiles and limits, exact DXF modeler-data group semantics, and an optional read-focused 2D DWG comparator; refine existing implementation readiness only.

method.kind: Static review of Autodesk DXF references and primary upstream project documentation/source
method.sourcePinning: Autodesk documentation links are versioned; cq-acis and ezdwg main-branch source/docs are mutable. The raw cq-acis source snapshot was reviewed directly on 2026-10-16 but no immutable SHA or runtime package was pinned. Before an optional differential run, record exact release, commit/package hash, input hashes, platform and options.
method.evidenceRule: Separate DXF carrier syntax, SAB record framing, resource admission, opaque history retention, DWG/AcDs association, typed projection, B-rep validity and downstream/native acceptance. Peer parser behavior and limits are comparative implementation evidence, not normative format rules.

evidence.topic: DXF inline modeler data has ordered payload chunks and a distinct history handle
evidence.observed: The 3DSOLID, BODY and REGION DXF references identify an AcDbModelerGeometry subclass, group 70 modeler format version, group 1 proprietary data lines shorter than 255 characters, and optional group 3 continuation data when a preceding group 1 string exceeds 255 characters. The 3DSOLID reference then identifies AcDb3dSolid and group 350 as a soft-owner handle to a history object. Autodesk's general group-code guidance says not to assume the tabulated group-code order and permits future codes, but that does not make repeatable payload chunks or subclass transitions interchangeable.
doesNotEstablish: DWG section or AcDs byte layout
the contents or semantic correctness of ACIS history
that group 350 contains modeler payload bytes or a payload size
ACIS B-rep validity or consumer acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep inline DXF ModelerGeometry, R2013+ DXF ACDSDATA and DWG AcDs separate. Preserve group 1/3 concatenation order and subclass boundaries; test the 255-character continuation rule, group 70, and group 350 handle association separately. Do not reorder repeated fragments based on generic group-order flexibility.

evidence.topic: cq-acis has useful bounded parser dimensions but does not validate declared record count
evidence.observed: The reviewed source defines defaults of 64 MiB input, 500,000 records, 4,000,000 tokens, 4 MiB per individual string, and subtype nesting depth 64. The string check is per string; no cumulative retained-string counter is apparent in the inspected parser. It stores the nonnegative header record_count, but the reviewed parser loop does not compare that value with the parsed record total at EOF. The source admits ACIS BinaryFile version 21800 and selected ASM BinaryFile4/BinaryFile8 version numbers; the profile notes qualify ASM BinaryFile8 as synthetic framing coverage only. Recognized history markers retain the marker-to-EOF bytes opaquely; contents and terminal framing are not parsed, while preceding active references are checked before publishing the model.
doesNotEstablish: normative SAB/ASM count, terminal or history behavior
complete support for all advertised geometry layouts
DWG container extraction or AcDs association
independent kernel semantics; its shape conversion uses CadQuery/OpenCascade
that mutable main-branch code and published release documentation identify the same exact revision
evidence.planUse: Use peer limit categories to audit libdxfrw ownership, not as default constants. Define per-string and cumulative retained-string budgets separately, and account independently for bytes, records, tokens, depth, references/work, history, copies, temporary capacity, output and diagnostics. Keep declared-count policy separate from actual work admission and framing completeness; do not copy the peer's lack of count comparison. Pin an immutable revision for any optional parser-structure differential.

evidence.topic: ezdwg is an optional common-2D comparator, not a 3D/ACIS qualification source
evidence.observed: The project documents a Rust-core, read-focused DWG parser for AC1012 through AC1032 and a native DWG writer restricted to an AC1015 subset. Its DWG-to-DXF conversion uses ezdxf and is explicitly best-effort with skipped-entity reporting. Its examples/tests can help identify common 2D records for a pinned comparison, but its version matrix is not a semantic per-entity guarantee. It is published by the same organization as cq-acis, so organizational provenance is shared although the implementation paths differ.
doesNotEstablish: per-version or per-entity semantic parity from the headline version range
writer parity outside the documented narrow writer scope
independent semantic geometry or independent organizational provenance
evidence.planUse: At a composed checkpoint only, select overlapping common 2D fields and versions supported by exact pinned revisions. Record actual input/output versions, build, diagnostics, per-record coverage and lineage. Add no dependency and do not import peer fixture files.

evidence.topic: Local outcome API remains a framing outcome, not a semantic certificate
evidence.observed: At the baseline working tree, the additive SAB outcome reports candidate/consumed/trailing spans, terminal presence, count-known/matched and complete state. The local ACIS 21800 count-zero exception requires terminal-at-EOF for complete; positive declared counts must match actual records but do not acquire a universal terminal requirement. Legacy bool wrappers reject incomplete suffixes; detailed APIs can expose a parsed prefix as incomplete. Existing generated cases are framing vectors, not complete ACIS models.
doesNotEstablish: body-root placement, topology or B-rep validity
a universal count/terminal policy for other profiles
evidence.planUse: Keep the existing ACIS 21800 exception isolated. Define complete as accepted-profile framing only. Resolve profile-specific history and alternate-signature policy from exact producer evidence before expanding acceptance; add outcome states only where an evidenced caller contract requires them.

implementationReadinessChanges: Refine S3.7a with an evidence/confidence table for exact signature/version, declared-count policy, count inclusion, terminal policy, history suffix behavior and consumed/trailing span.
Refine 7S.3 resource accounting with separate per-string and cumulative retained-string budgets plus explicit charges for copies, temporary capacity, opaque history, output geometry and diagnostics.
Keep declared format count, actual record/work admission, active-record stream closure, opaque history retention and semantic completeness as separate counters/states.

Add generated in-memory boundary vectors for string and aggregate budgets, record/token/depth/work limits, count mismatch, terminal/suffix outcomes, supported opaque-history preservation, truncation, unsupported signature, atomic failure and reuse; do not add external binary fixtures.
Add owner-scoped DXF cases for group 1/3 ordering and boundary, subclass transition, group 70, and group 350 handle association; retain existing 2D reader/writer and LibreCAD compatibility checks.
Use cq-acis only as an optional pinned parser-structure comparison and ezdwg only for overlapping 2D comparisons at a composed checkpoint; neither is a required dependency or per-slice blocker.
Keep per-slice validation to strict affected builds, focused fast tests, lc3_compat_check and git diff --check; run one composed sanitizer checkpoint and retain scheduled full-suite/fuzz cadence.
